# 3 B's Tree Removal

> Tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, storm cleanup, and skid steer dirt work for Central and Southwest Louisiana. Based in Pitkin, Louisiana.

3 B's Tree Removal takes on the big, tough jobs for homeowners. The owner, Blake Berry, is an LDAF licensed arborist for tree work, based in Pitkin, Louisiana. Blake’s a Louisiana Licensed Arborist and he’ll come check it out. The business also does skid steer dirt work and lot clearing.

The page never books the job. Enter an address, tell them about the job, and pick a time to call. They review the photo and the satellite view, and confirm the real price when they call back.

## Services

- Hazardous tree removal: Taking down dangerous or unwanted trees, including work near homes.
- Professional trimming: Pruning for health, clearance, and a cleaner look around your property.
- Storm cleanup: Downed limbs, storm-damaged trees, and urgent yard recovery.
- Stump grinding: Grind stumps below grade so the yard can be used again.
- Skid steer and dirt work: Skid steer dirt work and lot clearing.
- Also listed on the page: trees, stumps, land clearing, dirt work, and storm cleanup.
- Quote form job types: limb cut, whole tree removal, stump grinding, or not sure.

## How a visit starts

1. Enter your address and pick it from the list, then start the quote.
2. Tell them how many trees, how many stumps, and the job type. A photo of the trees or stumps is optional.
3. Pick a day, a time, and how soon you need it done. Blake’s a Louisiana Licensed Arborist and he’ll come check it out. They call at the time you picked.
